items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And two good examples of that was Taft Jordan and Shad Collins.

ctx.x: There's a difference in a New York trumpet player's solo and a soloist from Kansas City or Omaha. And two good examples of that was Taft Jordan and Shad Collins. To me they played like all the trumpet players played in New York, the style. And we even, take little Taft Smith, we had a different kind of approach to playing a solo.
And sometimes when Shad was in our band he would play like Taft Jordan who was with .........
